description: Fontaines à proximité des arrêts de transport en commun d’Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données recense les fontaines d’eau potable situées à proximité arrêts de métro, rer, train et tramway en Île-de-France. Il permet de visualiser l’accessibilité à l’eau potable autour des principaux points de transport en commun de la région. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructures. Its keywords are Arrêts. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
